name: mail-assistant
description: Email upgrade for Claude: attachments, inline images, any font (Calibri etc.), drafts and permission-controlled sending.
long_description: Creates emails as ready-to-review drafts with file attachments, inline images and any font. Sending is off by default; you choose between draft only, ask before sending, or autonomous sending to an allow-list.

tools.name: email_draft
tools.description: Create an unsent draft in DIN 5008 layout with attachments, inline images and any font

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Check a mail against DIN 5008 and show the exact layout

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send a draft according to the permission level

tools.name: email_profile_get
tools.description: Show profile, sign-off preview and permission level

tools.name: email_profile_set
tools.description: Save name, closing, signature, language, font and SMTP host

tools.name: email_permissions_set
tools.description: Change the permission level (only on the user's request)

smtp_password.title: App password (only needed for sending)
smtp_password.description: Use an app password from your mail provider, not your normal password.
